instruction: Open https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/waterlevels.html?id=8518750. Request verified hourly observed water levels at The Battery, New York, for September 12-13 2025 in metres relative to MLLW and GMT. Choose the 1 hr interval and apply it with Data Only; six-minute observations or predictions are not the requested product. The outcome is initiation of the correctly configured observation-data request; a saved file is not required. Use Data Only to initiate the JSON observation-data request.
